scope: 387 poses sampled at 60 Hz: 73 sit-down, 241 typing, 73 stand-up. The full office and picker share the corrected pose and furniture sources.
method: CPU-skinned body vertices against desk/chair box and cylinder interiors; arm vertices against original helmet sphere; distal arm vertices against posed torso; minimum foot height relative to rug. Furniture-interior tolerance 0.003 scene units.
visual_review: Seated typing and both transitions checked from side and reverse views in the picker.
limitations: Sampled vertex checks and visual inspection, not proof of continuous triangle-to-triangle collision freedom.
